title: Copilot model deprecations, Fable 5.2, Codex exec trust
summary: In short: [Upcoming deprecation of selected GitHub Copilot models in December](https://github.blog/changelog/2026-11-13-upcoming-deprecation-of-selected-github-copilot-models-in-december/): On 2026-12-14 Copilot drops Claude Fable 5, Claude Haiku 4.5, Gemini 3.8 Flash, Gemini 4 Argon, Grok 4.6 and Kimi K3 across all Copilot experiences. The suggested alternatives are Claude Fable 5.2, Claude Haiku 5.5, Gemini 4 Hydrogen, Gemini 4 Carbon and Grok 4.7. No replacement for Kimi K3 has been announced yet. Haiku 4.5 stays for individual subscribers on annual plans; [Claude Code v2.1.321](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.321): Claude Fable 5.2 (`claude-fable-5-2`) is now the default Fable model, with 1M context at $8/$40 per Mtok and $0.20/Mtok cache reads. GitHub made it generally available in Copilot the same day for Pro+, Max, Business and Enterprise, with data retention required by default; [Codex 0.169.0](https://github.com/openai/codex/releases/tag/rust-v0.169.0): `codex exec` keeps project configuration and MCP servers disabled in untrusted directories, even with `--sandbox workspace-write`. Add `--trust` to `codex exec` or `codex review` to save project trust

items.title: Claude Code v2.1.321
items.text: Added Claude Fable 5.2 (`claude-fable-5-2`), now the default Fable model — 1M context, $8/$40 per Mtok with $0.20/Mtok cache reads

items.title: Claude Fable 5.2 in GitHub Copilot
items.text: Claude Fable 5.2, Anthropic’s newest Fable model, is now generally available in GitHub Copilot.

items.title: Claude Code v2.1.322
items.text: Added fast mode on Vertex in the global, us and eu regions, falling back to standard speed if Vertex refuses it

items.title: ChatGPT for iOS 1.2026.307
items.text: Paste images and files into the full-screen composer, and open file attachments from sent prompts.

items.title: Gemini CLI v0.68.0
items.text: feat(cli): add extension validation command and evaluation tests

items.title: C++ language server now auto-configures MSBuild builds
items.text: The Microsoft C++ Language Server for GitHub Copilot CLI now bundles its MSBuild compile commands extractor and invokes it automatically.

items.title: Gemini 4 Carbon in GitHub Copilot
items.text: Gemini 4 Carbon, Google’s latest model, is now generally available in GitHub Copilot.

items.title: GitHub App support for Enterprise Copilot seat management
items.text: Enterprise GitHub Apps can now call the enterprise-level Copilot seat management APIs to control which users and enterprise teams are assigned Copilot seats.

items.title: Codex 0.167.2
items.text: Codex now sends tool updates incrementally by default on Google Cloud Vertex AI. To opt out, set `incremental_tools_legacy_gcp = false` under `[features]` in `config.toml`.

items.title: Claude Code v2.1.323
items.text: Added Code Mode, an experimental opt-in in which Claude writes JavaScript to call its tools; see https://code.claude.com/docs/en/code-mode to turn it on, or to turn it off for an organization

items.title: Claude Code v2.1.325
items.text: Fixed a security issue in how zstd-compressed responses are decoded

items.title: Codex 0.168.0
items.text: Browse model providers under Sessions → Model providers and choose the default for new chats.

items.title: Codex 0.169.0
items.text: `codex exec` keeps project configuration and MCP servers disabled in untrusted directories, even with `--sandbox workspace-write`. Use `--trust` with `codex exec` or `codex review` to explicitly save project trust.

items.title: Gemini 4 Hydrogen in GitHub Copilot
items.text: Gemini 4 Hydrogen, Google’s latest Flash model, is now generally available in GitHub Copilot.

items.title: GitHub Enterprise Server support in the GitHub Copilot app
items.text: You can now bring your work on GitHub Enterprise Server (GHES) into the GitHub Copilot app.

items.title: Upcoming deprecation of selected GitHub Copilot models in December
items.text: We will deprecate the following models across all GitHub Copilot experiences (including Copilot Chat, inline edits, ask and agent modes, and code completions) on December 14, 2026
